summaries.text: Rachel Moreno lives at 4417 NE Brookside Ave in Portland. Husband Tom is an ER nurse at Halverson Medical Center, working Wednesday, Thursday and Friday nights, 7 pm to 7 am; avoid scheduling before mid-afternoon afterward. Daughter Lily is nine, in 4th grade at Maplewood Elementary, Ms. Alvarez's Room 14; dismissal is 2:50. Pepper is their six-year-old beagle; vet: Dr. Ana Huang, Larchmont Animal Hospital. Neighbor Greg Pullman at 4421 holds their spare key.

Tom is allergic to penicillin. His cell is (503) 555-0161. He loves Thai food and anything spicy, but cannot stand cilantro. His best friend from college, Owen Fischer, lives in Vancouver, in Kitsilano. Tom has a mandatory monthly training day, usually the first Tuesday, 8 to 4.

Priya is allergic to all shellfish, cooked or raw, including shrimp, crab, lobster and scallops; her allergist confirmed this last spring, and she carries an epinephrine auto-injector. Hidden shrimp in dumplings caused a reaction at her office party; she recovered after an antihistamine. Account for the allergy when planning food. Always text her rather than call. She is an architect at Okafor & Lind; partner: Dev Shah; birthday: March 28; current address: 1835 NE Alder St.

Lily's winter concert is Wednesday the 17th at 6 pm in the school gym; she plays the recorder. Her homework routine includes a reading log for 20 minutes every night, signed by a parent on Fridays. Rachel wants Friday evening reminders to sign it because she often forgets until Monday morning.

Rachel is leading the Atlas study, researching the new onboarding flow for Tandem, Fernhill Software's scheduling app. Her manager is Jordan Hale, Director of Design; protect their fixed 1:1 every Monday at 11. Marcus Lee is the research coordinator responsible for participant recruitment. Dana Kim works in research ops and handles incentives and tools.

Rachel's holiday gift budget is about $600 total. Gift list: Lily, a real watercolor set and Moon Fox book 5; Tom, a good chef's knife; Mom, a photo calendar with pictures of Lily; Priya, the fig candle she liked; Greg and June next door, a tin of Rachel's ginger cookies. Rachel wants purchase tracking. The candle is ordered; later updates confirm Lily received the watercolor set, Tom received the knife, and Mom's calendar arrived late.

Lily has a sesame allergy, diagnosed when she was four. Her epinephrine auto-injectors are in her backpack's front pocket and the kitchen drawer next to the fridge. Her allergist is Dr. Okonkwo and pediatrician is Dr. Sato, both at Willow Creek Pediatrics. Watch for tahini, hummus, sesame oil and seeded buns; always ask restaurants what oil they use. Lily dislikes mushrooms, but that is not an allergy.

Lily's winter break is December 22 to January 2. She is enrolled in art camp at Clay & Code, December 29 to 31, 9 to 3 each day. The $165 fee is already paid. Rachel wants drop-off reminders the night before each camp day.

Tom's brother Luis and his wife Carmen live in Beaverton and have two children: Mateo, seven, and Sofia, four. They hosted Christmas Eve at 5 pm with a Korean menu. Rachel is lactose intolerant and planned to bring a dairy-free pear tart; she requested a pear and almond tart recipe with an olive-oil crust. Luis was told not to use sesame oil on anything Lily eats; the later recap confirmed her plate was sesame-free.

Pepper had her annual shots on Thursday and is done for the year. She eats salmon and rice kibble, one cup twice a day. She weighs 26 lb, and Dr. Huang wants her to lose about two pounds. No more table scraps; Rachel particularly wants Tom reminded.

Luis kept Lily's Christmas dinner plate sesame-free. Lily received and loved the watercolor set; Tom received and loved the knife. Mom's photo calendar arrived late and is expected to reach her by New Year. Tom's parents, Ana and Ricardo, live in Phoenix; the family calls them most Sundays. Ana and Ricardo's summer visit is tentative, with no dates yet.

The family car is a blue 2019 hatchback; registration renewal is due April 30. Tom's birthday is April 11, and Rachel wants to plan something and keep an ideas list. Rachel's New Year resolutions include running 5 km with Priya on Sunday mornings and continuing left-shoulder physio at Kestrel Physio on Monday mornings at 7:30, booked through the end of March.

Rachel's doctor is Dr. Lewis at Hawthorne Family Medicine. Her annual physical is due in April; she wants a reminder to book it in the first week of April, but not while the family is in Vancouver. She takes vitamin D every morning, wears contacts, and orders new contacts in May.

Rachel's mother, Elena Ruiz, lives in Sacramento, is a retired second-grade teacher, and has a June 14 birthday. She has type 2 diabetes and a rising A1C; she is avoiding sugar and white rice, favoring brown rice, beans and vegetables. Cook low-sugar meals during visits. Stairs remain difficult after knee surgery in October; she will use the downstairs den sofa bed, not the upstairs guest room. A late March visit around Lily's spring break is tentative.

Elena takes metformin 500 mg twice a day, with breakfast and with dinner, and Lisinopril 10 mg every morning for blood pressure. She checks her blood sugar every morning before breakfast. Her doctor in Sacramento is Dr. Meera Patel. When she stays with Rachel, bring her pill organizer from the bathroom to the kitchen.

Rachel is traveling to Austin for the Field Research Forum, February 17 to 19, and giving a talk on the 18th. Tom works Wednesday and Thursday nights that week, so Luis and Carmen will keep Lily overnight on the 18th. Rachel wants the trip and overnight on the calendar. Flight details will arrive by email.
Rachel is hiring a junior UX researcher. Interviews are the week of January 26; hold Tuesday and Thursday afternoons, 1 to 4, for interviews.

Lily's passport expired on December 9 and needs renewal for the Vancouver trip. Rachel plans to do the paperwork this weekend; Lily needs a new passport photo first. Rachel wants a reminder to start the renewal. Tom's passport is valid until 2029 and Rachel's until 2027, so only Lily's needs renewal.

Atlas study plan (v2): identify where new Tandem users drop out of onboarding. Plan for 12 participants in 60-minute remote sessions, February 9 to March 6. Each participant receives a $75 gift card, handled by Dana Kim. Marcus Lee handles recruiting and scheduling. Research questions cover account setup friction, calendar connection, and first shared schedule.

The dishwasher broke; a Rose Appliance repair technician is scheduled for Wednesday the 21st between noon and 4. Rachel ordered tomato and basil seeds for the garden and plans to plant in May, after the last frost.

Leadership wants the Atlas readout before the end of Q1; the target is Tuesday March 24. The presentation should be 30 minutes plus Q&A, with the top three recommendations up front. Rachel does not want prep time blocked yet because sessions end in early March. Marcus is recruiting the 12 participants.

Mortgage autopay is on the 1st. Cascadia Fiber internet is $70, on autopay on the 15th. Pepper's pet insurance is $38 a month. Lily's college savings receives a $200 automatic transfer on the 1st. Car insurance renews June 10.

Greg offered to feed Pepper and water the plants whenever the family is away. However, Greg and his wife June will be in Arizona from March 28 to April 5, so he cannot help during the Vancouver trip. Rachel plans to board Pepper at Happy Tails again because she liked it last time; booking is not confirmed.

Rachel's left-shoulder appointments at Kestrel Physio are Mondays at 7:30 am with Sam Whitford, PT. The last booked session is Monday March 30, followed by reassessment, clarifying the earlier booking through the end of March. Home exercises are band rows and wall slides, daily.

Lily's best friend is Ava Brooks; Ava's mom is Nicole Brooks. Rachel signed Lily up and paid $40 for the term for school art club, Wednesdays after school. Lily loves the Moon Fox graphic novels and is on book four. Rachel's book club meets the second Thursday each month; she is hosting February 12 at 7 pm, reading The Lantern Keepers. She requested a shopping reminder the day before.

Rachel's mom changed her phone number to (916) 555-0172; use this number instead of the old one. She is visiting Portland and flies home Thursday April 2. Rachel deferred arranging the airport pickup calendar entry until closer to the date.

Rachel is hosting eight people for book club at home on February 12. Jess is vegan and Marie is gluten-free. Rachel plans a big lentil salad and a flourless chocolate cake. She requested a shopping list for Wednesday and a reminder to borrow two folding chairs from Greg.
Imani Cole was hired as junior UX researcher, starting March 2. Rachel will mentor her, with a weekly 1:1 on Wednesdays at 2 pm once she starts.

Rachel mailed Lily's passport renewal on February 9, expedited for $60 extra. Processing is expected to take 5 to 7 weeks, with arrival by about March 31, before the Vancouver departure April 3. Rachel requested a March 27 check-in; if it has not arrived, she could call the passport agency for an appointment.

Rachel's Austin trip for the Field Research Forum: Tue Feb 17, PDX to AUS, departs 7:05 am and arrives 1:10 pm. Hotel: Congress Avenue Inn, two nights, confirmation 7730-QK. Her talk is Wed Feb 18 at 11:30 am, room B. Return Thu Feb 19, AUS to PDX, departs 3:25 pm and arrives 6:40 pm.

Harbourview Suites, Vancouver reservation for Rachel Moreno: check-in Friday, April 3, 2026, from 4 pm; check-out Monday, April 6, 2026, by 11 am. Room has two queen beds and is non-smoking. Confirmation HV-48213. Parking is CAD 28 per night, arranged at the front desk. Free cancellation until March 30.

Rachel booked Vancouver for April 3 to 6 and plans to drive up Friday morning. Tom's Friday night, April 3 shift remains unresolved; he is asking coworker Kendra to swap. Rachel wants to visit the aquarium and Granville Island; Lily wants the suspension bridge. Rachel approved planning the aquarium Saturday morning and Granville Island that afternoon.

Pepper, a beagle, is booked at Happy Tails Lodge: drop-off Friday, April 3, 7:30 am; pick-up Monday, April 6, by 6 pm. Bring her own food and any medications with written instructions. Vaccination records are on file.
Rachel and Tom enjoyed a date night at Luce on Division on February 14. Remember it as a favorite for quiet dinners. Tom loved the tiramisu. Rachel cannot do dairy and had the olive oil cake.
Rachel booked two seats for Tom's birthday at Saltbox Kitchen's handmade pasta cooking class on Saturday April 11, $95 each. It is a surprise and should remain private from Tom.

Vancouver itinerary: Fri Apr 3, drop Pepper at Happy Tails 7:30, leave by 8:30; about 5.5 hours driving, passports for all three. Sat Apr 4: aquarium at 10 am, tickets bought; Granville Island afternoon. Sun Apr 5: suspension bridge, tickets not bought; dinner with Tom's college friend Owen in Kitsilano, not confirmed. Mon Apr 6: check out by 11, drive home, pick up Pepper by 6 pm.

Lily Moreno is enrolled in Level 4 swim lessons at Eastside Aquatic Center, Tuesdays 5:00-5:45 pm, March 3 to May 19. Instructor: Jordan Pike. Cancel by texting Coach Jordan at (503) 555-0123 before noon on the lesson day. Missed lessons can be made up on Saturday mornings.
Ms. Alvarez says Lily needs more multiplication facts practice. Rachel plans 15 minutes of math games every day after school, before screen time, with a 3:30 reminder on weekdays.

Trailhead Outfitters order TO-55817, a kids' teal rain jacket, size 10, was delivered February 25, 2026. Returns are accepted by March 27, 2026, unworn with tags attached, at any store or by mail using the prepaid label.

Maplewood Elementary spring break is Monday March 30 to Friday April 3. Monday April 6 is a teacher planning day with no school; classes resume Tuesday April 7. The 4th grade science museum field trip is Friday March 27. Spring picture day is Thursday April 16.
Lily's size 10 rain jacket is too big. Rachel plans to return it at the Trailhead store on Hawthorne and get an 8; tags are still on. Lily wears an 8 in clothes and a size 2 in shoes.

Rachel changed the furnace filter Mar 1; the next one is due in June. Gutter cleaning is booked with Clearline Gutters for Saturday April 18. Bell & Sons Plumbing replaced a washer on November 14 after the kitchen sink leaked under the cabinet.
Ms. Alvarez reports that Lily is doing well in reading. Multiplication facts are a topic for the spring parent-teacher conference, which is a 20-minute appointment.

Priya and Dev leased an apartment in Sellwood. Rachel plans to treat Priya to birthday dinner on March 28 at Olive & Ash on Belmont, 7:30. Priya wants somewhere cozy and not loud; Dev is away that weekend, so it will be just Rachel and Priya. Rachel plans to call the restaurant herself; no booking is confirmed. Olive & Ash offers whole grilled fish and veggie plates.

Lumberlane Furniture order LL-20931: Elevate standing desk, oak top, 60 in. Delivery is scheduled Monday, March 23, 2026, between 1 pm and 5 pm. An adult must sign. A two-person crew will assemble it on site, taking about 45 minutes.
Imani's first two days went well; she will shadow the last Atlas sessions that week. Rachel's desk arrives on the 23rd, replacing her kitchen-table office setup. Delivery requires an adult to sign.
The Atlas readout moved because the leadership offsite moved; it is now Wednesday March 25 at 10 am. Jordan needs the deck by Monday March 23 at noon to review it.
Rachel planned to help Priya pack on March 6, bringing extra boxes from the garage. For Ava's birthday party, Rachel approved a sketchbook and brush pens as Lily's gift, under $25.

Priya moved in on Saturday. Her new address is 2290 SE Linnet St, Apt 4B, Portland, OR 97202. Priya and Dev returned the old place's keys; nothing should go to the old address. Dev threw his back out lifting the couch during the move.
Lily's parent-teacher conference was rescheduled because of a district training day. The new slot is Monday, March 23, at 4:30 pm, Room 14. Reply to Ms. Alvarez if this time does not work.

The airline cancelled Rachel's mom's original arrival flight. She now arrives in Portland Thursday March 26 at 2:15 pm on flight 2214. She still flies home April 2. Pick her up at the curb rather than parking; she has a small suitcase.

Marcus Lee's last day before paternity leave is Friday; he returns May 11. His baby is due next week. Dana Kim is covering Atlas recruiting while he is out and has the screener, participant tracker and incentive budget. Recruiting stands at 10 of 12 participants confirmed, with two slots open. Route recruiting questions to Dana until May 11.

The kitchen sink is leaking under the cabinet again. Marcus from Bell & Sons Plumbing suspects the drain trap seal and is booked Friday March 20, between 8 and 10 am. His cell is (503) 555-0186; Greg next door can let him in if Rachel is on a call. Rachel's Fennel Street Dental cleaning moved to Tuesday March 31 at 8:00 am because Dr. Feld is out.
Ava's sleepover with Lily is set for Friday March 27, after the field trip, rather than Saturday the 28th because that is Priya's dinner night.

Lily attended Ava's party and came home exhausted. Priya's housewarming is Saturday April 11 at 6 pm. That is Tom's birthday, so Rachel told Priya they might arrive late. Lily's swim coach says she is ready for Level 5 after this session.
Kiln & Co order KC-3390 is a hand-thrown teapot in glaze 'sea fog'. It shipped March 16, with estimated delivery Wednesday, March 25, to 4417 NE Brookside Ave, Portland.

Pepper saw Dr. Huang on March 16 for another left ear infection. She needs ear drops twice a day, morning and night, through Sunday March 22; she hates them. If she is still shaking her head on Sunday, Rachel should call the clinic. Otherwise, the recheck is March 30 at 5:15 pm. The assistant agreed to remind Rachel about the drops and recheck.
Tom found a permission slip in Lily's backpack for the science museum field trip on the 27th. It needs a parent signature and $12 cash, due Friday. Rachel requested a reminder Thursday evening.

Priya's birthday dinner is planned for Saturday March 28, 7:30 pm, at Olive & Ash on Belmont; it is NOT booked yet. Reservations are by phone only: (503) 555-0147. The gift is the teapot from Kiln & Co, arriving the 25th. Rachel needs to wrap it and drop it off at Priya's new place before Saturday.

Dana says the last two Atlas participants are scheduled for Friday and will send Rachel the final participant list Monday morning. Tom booked the car at Eastside Auto Care for Saturday at 9 am for an oil change and tire rotation. Rachel is taking it because Tom will be asleep after his Friday shift. Kendra has not answered about swapping April 3; Tom will ask Mike if she says no. Tom's April 3 shift remains open.
